name: Aquila
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth; and found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome.

note.label: Israel Called Gentiles, Strangers, Heathen & Saints

points: “And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly”. When they heard Apollos they said, man, this guy’s strong, but he’s missing something. So they sat him down: brother, you’re something else, but do you know this? They told him about Christ; he didn’t know nothing about Christ, all he knew was John’s baptism. They sat him down and said, listen, this is what happened, this is the story. And Apollos didn’t say, listen, I know the scriptures already, you can’t tell me a damn thing. He received it, and he went out there and started teaching it.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
